title: Excellent
content:
This app is so good it competes with handheld GPS in locations with GPS service. 

I do volunteer field surveying and a feature that’d really make this app complete is the ability to drop waypoints and save libraries of specific GPS locations. This is handy for people planning new routes, marking the nearest safe places on a solo hikes, storing location data on where specific flora or fauna were located in national parks etc.
author: David3951

title: Just downloaded and it’s already useful
content:
I think I’m going to get a lot of use from this app.  Lots of local trails to explore. 
But…
In Australia, we use the metric system, and that means energy usage is measured in kiloJoules, not calories. Can you please fix this, or at least have kiloJoules/calories as an extra choice. The energy tracking is meaningless for me otherwise.
author: Bruce@PrestonPlace

title: Great value and easy to use
content:
Love it for all kinds of reasons but mainly:

- being able to search for great walks 
- having so much useful info on each walk, including duration, difficulty, elevation etc
-real time tracking which knows where you are, even if you deviate from the main path; this makes it easy to explore smaller, unmapped trails
author: Douglasadamsrules

title: Wouldn’t hike without All Trails
content: This app has become my map, my safety plan and my memory tool for all things hiking. I love the offline map feature and the ability to plan ahead when travelling by finding some trails near where I’m going and downloading them in readiness. The navigation feature capturing my actual path is a gem. Thanks for this one!!!!!
author: MelChW

title: A recent convert
content: I have just discovered the full benefits of AllTrails. I am currently hiking in the European Alps. Yesterday my local companions were using a Swiss hiking app and promoting its benefits. However I was able to show them the trail alternatives (and there were many) with much greater accuracy using AllTrails. They were impressed!! and we saved a lot of unnecessary steps in reaching our destination.
author: Q12985

title: Just hopeless
content:
Downloaded it. Tried to open a map. Got the following message: “Unavailable offline. Please check your internet connection”. Checked it. Got same message again and then again. 

Of course I have an internet connection. Four bars. I downloaded the app after all. My internet connection is as good as it is ever going to get. 

Tried to open a map again. Got the following message; “Oops. Something went wrong. Tap to try again.”

Glad I found out how useless the app is before using it out in the bush. 

Maybe it works in other countries, but if you’re trying to use it in Australia don’t waste your time.
author: Meanderer123&@$)(;:/

title: Okay app
content:
As I got more into hiking, I see myself using AllTrails less and less, especially during the activity. The start button on the bottom right is little difficult to work with. Slightest touch triggers activity and have to delete it - which happen over and over again.

So I am slowly moving out from AllTrails app and relying on Garmin map fully. I still find it as a great route finding app and I hope that will be the case.
author: PineAppleMeltInThePod

title: Good app but lacks some features
content:
I have been using all trails to find some mtb tracks in my areas. It has showed me some cool places that I never would have gone normally however last two tracks I have driven over an hour and a half to fine it’s prohibited to ride MTBs on. Also the maps not having the always in feature is very frustrating. 
Good overall but I think there are better mtb track maps out there.
author: Morgzy04

title: Misleading
content:
I’ve downloaded this app after seeing an ad on Instagram stating that it will tell you if the trail is dog friendly as I would not go on a hike without my dog. 
I’ve clicked on 10 trails near where I live and absolutely no indication if the trails allow dogs or not. So disappointing. I will remove this app from my phone as it’s not doing the job for me and just use Google. Other than that the app is beautifully made and allows you to see straight away the level of difficulty. There is also a weather forecast to plan your hike which is a great idea.
author: Ninaha13

title: Top 5 App
content: The best there is for finding trails. Use it weekly. Super intuitive and always on the mark. The only thing they need to add is route builder in app for the more dedicated outdoor enthusiasts (AllTrails has moved away from that in recent years to capture more growth/audience and appears to be losing share to Kamoot and Strava in this space but could catch up and regain).
author: Scott7564

title: Maps were accurate.
content:
The maps are very accurate & I was amazed at the number of trails available around Paluma in North Queensland Australia. 
Such an obscure location but so well documented. 
I found trying to save & navigate the menu system , a bit difficult.
A bit more practice may be needed.
author: Mpilko

title: Simply exceptional
content: This is an incredible app- any time anywhere around home or on a trip I can find the sort of walk or hike I really would like to do given time available and level of difficulty. No more getting lost either! I don’t need ph reception to maintain location. It is now one of my key apps. Wonderful!
author: Hans Red

title: Stunning Beautiful Walk
content: Two days exploring the ancient sandstone landscapes of Carnarvon Gorge, completing the full network of walks across the gorge. Day one included Big Bend, Cathedral Cave and the Art Gallery with its remarkable Indigenous rock art, while day two tackled the climb to Boolimba Bluff before visiting the Amphitheatre and the lush Moss Garden. An unforgettable trek through towering cliffs, creek crossings and hidden pockets of this remarkable gorge system.
author: DLM1961

title: GPS
content: I would recommend this app as a substitute for GPS devices, it works as a charm even when we go offline. I am subscribing to pro. I would also like to request developers to bring subscription fee little bit  down, so that everyone can subscribe without thinking twice.
author: Bnodthebe

title: Fail to see the fuss
content:
App is largely full of largely pointless or useless trails. Very little of genuine interest. 

Review system is pointless as any comments left, which might actually be useful, are hidden unless you tap on them individually, so impossible to get a quick scan check of whether something is actually worthwhile or not. 

As far as I can tell it’s basically a worse version of Strava but for walking (which Strava also does). Anyway, each to their own I guess
author: Jason’s Tim Tams

title: Broken since update
content: Best way to find new trails. This app literally changed my life. I don’t use it for tracking but the pro version is still worth every cent for exploring and having a quick map and height profile available on the trail to complement the paper maps.
author: Bernd.Meyer

title: Don’t Download, Don’t Subscribe for the premium
content:
This is a failed app. I subscribed for premium account. I logged out by mistake can’t login back. The password is not working. I tried to login from the website logged in but soon as logged out can’t get back in again. Reset the password logged in, tried to logging from the app, the password is not working. Something wrong with this whole thing. I strongly recommend do not download this app.

And dear developers, please help me to remove my premium membership. I can’t get myself out.
author: killermindxx

title: Pencil Pine Track
content:
Along with other reviewers, recommended is to walk clockwise & fair weather is also advised. As we discovered, some parts of the track, particularly the middle section,  become small rivulets after snow & rain. 

The traverse along the river is pretty exposed in places so be aware. What would Cradle be without a wombat sighting! There’s sweeping views of the Speeler Plain to the Vale of Belvoir from the high ground. A good workout.
author: taipan21

title: Latest updates create app instability and failures
content: App keeps crashing and has failed me with offline navigation/ maps as they keep dropping out and I then can’t reload them without internet access in remote areas … I have subscribed to Pro. This app is sadly unreliable for any navigation in recent months as I’ve been a long term subscriber and the functionality has been fabulous.
author: Legofun

title: Discovers trails very well but has issues
content:
The Apple Watch app is good for nothing. Each time I glanced at the watch, the app had lost focus. It still records, but having to reselect the app each time I want to glance the map, defeats the purpose of having it.
There’s also a problem capturing activity.
If I allow the fitness app to record activity as a workout, the AllTrails app shuts down, so the map is lost. If I don’t allow the fitness app to record activity, no record of the activity is kept.
The AllTrails app needs to link with the health app.
author: Omnious7

title: Good app but support is average
content: The app is really good and is used by a lot of people. GPX downloads don't work if you need to import the rough onto your wearable. That's fine but the issue I have is when you email support, they don't read the ticket and tell you what you've already told them is the problem. You'll get 1 chance of getting a response from support. After that, it's crickets. Very frustrating.
author: Helcker

title: AllTrails
content:
Basically great program, suggesting excellent  walks, from my prospective a must have app particularly in Australia. 
I do find that it is missing some trails, particularly in Tasmania, so the maps could do with some improvement. 
Also the menu to download the trail into a Garman device could be made more intuitive, eg I am more successful using Komoot to download trails into the device than AllTrails.
author: Herdygirdy

title: I actually love this app but…
content: It’s really good. Well laid out and community features are good but I’m paying for Plus to support the app and remove ads. Stop advertising for your even more expensive subscription on every page. I don’t want it, I’m already paying to not be advertised to and you’re providing these banner style advertisements. Stop.
author: laura.katherynn

title: The free version is worth having
content: They have three levels now which I personally think is a bit silly. I've talked to other hikers and most are more than willing to pay $20- $25 a year for a good hiking app but not these high prices that they now require for very little more content. So they just use the free version.  I tend to use Strava a lot or just my Garmin watch but I think AllTrails has a lot going for it.
author: Stephen2800

title: Fabulous app for hikes
content: Apart from streaming TV shows I don’t pay for any apps except this one is absolutely worth it. Have downloaded so many great hikes for use off-line. When I go somewhere new, I search for any walks within the area filtered down by the length difficulty etc. love it
author: bamm1976xx

title: Great app
content: This is a really great app if you like bush walking, hiking, mountain biking etc. the filters are good and allow you to customise your search to location, difficulty and distance. It also shows total elevation and map elevation so you are very clear about each trail. The only things I don’t like is it does not integrate with google maps so finding the start of some trails can be difficult
author: Khazdomi

title: Pay for ad free - get more ads!!
content:
If you upgrade to the paid version - SURPRISE!!! You get plastered with AllTrails ads to UPGRADE TO PEAK. Because spending a bit of money isn’t ok they have to hassle you for a lot more! Very annoying and the support crew don’t help. They gaslight you into thinking it’s not a problem.
Edit: I had a response from AllTrails asking me to reach out with ideas for improvement… I posted this review AFTER I had done that TWICE already. 
The “Upgrade to Peak” ad persists!!!!
author: RumGumby

title: A Hikers dream
content: All trails is such a great app for all levels of hiking. I love that you can see the grades of the hikes as well as comments made by other hikers. Being able to get real time information from those who have walked the track before you is so useful. I don’t use any other app.
author: Shifterworker123

title: Perfect adventure planning tool
content: The app is great. Paid version is not expensive and totally worth. Easy to filter the type of adventure you want. Reviews are really helpful for getting updates from recent hikers etc. Easy to use a navigate on app and web.
author: Vdub001

title: Dissapointment with maps!
content: After watching all the reviews on this app and using the free version for several years, I decided to upgrade to the pro version! My main reason was to download the maps to print as it was stated by AllTrails “why pay for expensive paper maps when you can print exactly what you want”! Sure, but don’t count on the quality of these maps, the resolution is terrible and sometimes illegible!
author: @Ntman

title: Fabulous app
content: My life has changed since using this app! My dog and i have not walked so far in our lives and we are exploring features of our city we never knew existed and some trails are right under our noses !!! Cannot wait to explore more of the world around me !! Thankyou alltrails
author: Sherryn1978

title: Best Hike App Ever!
content: Love this app I use it for my everyday walks with my dogs to longer day and over night hikes. It’s great being able to download maps for areas that are out of range. It keeps a log of how much you’ve been moving which is super motivating! love it! Just Get It! You won’t regret it!
author: Ali&Milo

title: Easy to use and so helpful!
content: I’m loving the app, the filters are great so you can search by activity, location, length, elevation and the best thing - what you want your experience to be like. Whether see a view, walk in a forest, go to a waterfall - it’s all in there. Thanks Alltrails crew for a job well done!!
author: Mrs_Fletch

title: Review of App
content: Uncertain how to place photos up or add extra tracks at locations some have shown .i know locally some locations I have seen review haven't been fully covered with all tracks and some photos shown by others could have been better examples of these beautiful locations with my local knowledge of them .

title: It’s really great! I should have downloaded it sooner!
content:
I have found so many new trails in my area and I’m excited to go hiking again.
There maps are really accurate and easy to follow, and tracking everything.
Would recommend to everyone!
author: Ja Ja Sphinx

title: Amazing app, so good for my solo hikes
content:
This App is a life saver because I like to hike solo and its does the job perfectly!!

I love it and it has never let me down. I download my Maps at home then use them offline on the trails. I like everything about how it works, its very easy to follow directions, such a good app
author: Chazchaz150

title: Wow...
content:
Frankly this is the app I’ve been waiting on for years. Love the interface, Watch support and level of polish in the UI. 

(Most other mapping/hiking apps look less like AirBnB, the ‘gold’ standard UI IMO and more like 80’s military software.)

Only thing missing is iPad support, not saying would take it much but my 4G iPad would be great on driving trails.
author: xcfdxxcx

title: Great interactive resource
content: Excellent resource for trail planning for hiking have used this multiple times on various trips it provides a valuable interactive video of trails and with user reviews and trail experiences providing an informative guide to future trail choices and trip planning I thoroughly recommend
author: ???md???

title: Fabulous App
content: I use this app all the time when going on hikes. The reviews are very helpful and the downloaded version of the hikes are great to help you stay on the correct path and have peace of mind you’re headed in the right direction. Would highly recommend!!
author: SMHooper

title: Very Helpful
content: We love all trails! Use it often when cycling or walking in new areas. Especially love the warnings that we have taken a wrong turn from the planned route. My only wish is there could be a way to record which routes we have previously done on a map or something.
author: Alllsies Explore

title: Hikers guide to the trails!
content:
LOVE this app, even more so since upgrading (which was so affordable)
It’s so easy to use and I like that it takes your location and gives you options close to you. 
I have been recommending this to all my friends! 
Great work and thank you.
author: CrumpetC

title: Love for All Trails
content: Asked if I love All Trails, I gave a resounding yes! The comprehensive coverage of trails globally is so good and when using the app, the directions are incredibly accurate. On a recent walk we went 20 metres up the wrong path and the app pulsed saying we had gone the wrong way - I was very impressed.
author: Altrails

title: Crashes constantly and repeatedly
content: Seems to be an issue since at least 22 December (see reviews). But four weeks later still there no change despite a few updates since.  and what is frustrating when you contact support (as suggested by developer)  they seem to have no idea and they keep asking me to do the same old script. Reset, reinstall, blah blah.  I have installed on three different devices with three different os’s and all crash every time in the same way everytime you open the map to search.
author: Swhallo

title: Discover More of Your Backyard with All Trails
content: This has become a go to app when I’m planning to do a new walk/hike. Very useful compendium to have. It’s an encyclopaedia of trails and covers so many areas as well as Perth. Discovered so much about my own backyard. The reviews and suggestions are useful tools to refer before trying out a trail. Thanks
author: NdruT

title: Disappointing
content:
Two main features missing from the pro version.
1. I can not download a section of the map for offline use unless its an established track that is listed in your database.  I signed up for pro version so that I can download a few acres of my farm map snd walk around offline as I don't have reception but wont allow me. Free google maps does🤷‍♂️.

2. Despite having multiple base map options, all are about the same in practice. I want to see a base map where the lot boundaries are visible, again I wanted to walk the boundaries of my farm but didn't know where I was. This is useful also  when you are hiking inna national park snd need to stay out of peoples private property. 

3. Can not navigate/record my walk in a national park in offline mode unless its a know hiking track.
author: AmeertheGoogleGuide

title: Integration to pre walk navigation
content: It would be a bonus to have the ability to get navigation information to the start of the walk from the start of my journey. I have had to type in gps coordinates to google maps on a number of occasions.
author: DJTG59

title: Love it
content:
I’ve been using this app for about a year now and it’s the best. 
I ended up getting the pro version and so glad I did. 
It’s very easy to use and has lots of features. 
I’ve tried other apps for walks and hikes and always come back to this app.
author: Jasrob69

title: Poorly Developed App
content: I use this app on my phone and like it. It is a very useful app for planning group and personal hikes. So very disappointing that the developers took the lazy way out and did not produce an iPad compatible app but merely emulated the phone app on the IPad. The display on the iPad is no bigger than on my iPhone! Why would I bother using an app that only uses about 1/5 of the Screen realestate?? Hopefully this oversight will be addressed in future versions of the app as an app fully developed for the iPad Screen would be great.
author: Drat48

title: Excellent app for tracking outdoors activity
content: This app is user friendly and easy to keep coming back to. I have used this app working in the outdoors and to track my hobbies and always found it reliable.
author: Botskioli

title: Never get lost again!
content:
AllTrails is the go-to resource for tracking live activity, logging stats and connecting with like minded others (if you want to)
As a solo female hiker, this app is a great companion, especially when setting out into the pre-dawn darkness for those mountain top sunrises.
author: Livingtherapies

title: Trekkers’ Love
content: This is beautifully designed app and highly useful for locating popular as well as off beat treks. Navigation features are pretty accurate too, and for anyone who lives to spend time out there in the wilds will find the app to be a good companion.
author: Charn S05

title: Glitch y’all
content: After a year of great usage the App failed at the finish of the ride. While saving the ride and going through the steps the screen turned black with a numeric display with data not correct and was frozen. I was eventually able to get around the freeze by opening the app through the apple App Store app. Then the comment screen was hidden and I couldn’t see what I was typing. Last year it was a good app, I would describe it as glitchy now.
author: %rse

title: Great app!
content: Use this all the time to find hikes, download the maps for tracking during hikes and record them after. It also lets you save and create categories for hikes to plan in advance :) overall no criticism. Love it 🙌🏽
author: Chimay*

title: A prompt when you stop
content: I really enjoy AllTrails, my major complaint is it doesn’t prompt you when you’ve stopped your activity, eg change from walking to in a vehicle. For those of us who forget to hit stop!
author: Grasee59

title: Helps you get out there!
content: Easy to use, helps you find where you want to go, what to expect and navigate the trail. Keeps track of where you’ve been too. Would give more stars if I could.
author: tskelding

title: Good but could be improved
content: One of my biggest gripes with AllTrails is if I am searching for a specific park then best match should weight trails in that park higher than walks elsewhere. It’s almost useless for looking for trails in a specific area unless you are already there (and in Australia, that could mean you’re unable to download the map). Please fix this issue.
author: Sarasvy

title: Great navigation app for hiking
content: all trails is the great app for hiking. This helps navigating the route and bring you home safe during hiking where it’s so easy to lose your path in a bush otherwise. I use it all the time and  highly recommend 🙏
author: Shlgbaj

title: Pasai Nature Park, Mi  try I, Malaysia
content:
After chasing hornbills and seeing none I decided to take a left turn into the jungle and get up close and personal but the track was like being in on the Kokoda Trail, lots of sink holes and jungle entrapping me.
But All Trails helped me out of the situation and got me back on track .
author: Devinopolous

title: Helpful
content: This app is amazing! Gives you all the details you need for planning your trip. I used it throughout the trip for Navigation and it didn‘t use that mich battery and my phone lasted for the whole day trip.
author: Marjan_a

title: App Crashes
content:
I can not get this app to work, I received a flippant response when I reached out for help.
When I open the app it just crashes after about 5 seconds. I was advised to delete the app and then reinstall, however doing this would delete all the data I have saved.. offloading doesn’t work either. I find it extremely frustrating that the only app I have paid for is the only app that doesn’t work! Is anyone able to help??
author: hvfgjkojcccf

title: Great aid
content: I’m only just getting started in Trail walking, and this app has been a great help. Downloadable trail maps for navigation and community reviews of the different trails help build confidence and make it much easier to get out and about.
author: Munkiben

title: An accurate and informative app
content: I am new to the app but am super impressed by it’s accuracy which seems to be within a metre or so. Also it highlights interesting objects along the way such as ancient ruins and caves. Definitely a good purchase and I haven’t even explored all of it’s features yet
author: whydoineedaflippinnickname

title: All Trails, All Good
content: I love the app. Easy to use, lots of options and community based. There’s always room for improvement but as it is, you’ll find places to explore almost anywhere. Our family will use this app while travelling overseas to explore not too touristy places.
author: LLMelbourne

title: No map in Apple Watch update
content: I love All Trails and have enjoyed using it with my Apple Watch until the most recent update, which has removed the map function. It was so helpful to be able to look at the map on my wrist without having to get my phone out to check which turns to take to follow a track. The current watch app is mostly useless to me.
author: Naomicoo

title: One glaring issue
content: For an app that’s purpose built for hiking and has an option to download individual trails, it’s pretty ridiculous that it’s not possible to view/use these downloaded trails without an active internet connection, especially considering that they’re often outside of areas with mobile reception.
author: gjfgjhgfdgyhbdbjgjudsb

title: Caution with deceptive practice
content: The app works fine, but be careful of the deceptive practice to lure you to upgrade to pro.  I have been receiving emails to promote the Black Friday special upgrade price, but whenever I try to follow the special offer link and logged into my account to upgrade, the special offer price disappears and normal price is there instead. Very deceptive and poor practice.
author: My.Gov user

title: Doesn't work with Apple watch
content: While the app on its own on the phone is great. I was never able to make it work properly with the apple watch. It would be a great functionality but the experience is so very frustrating. Downloading maps didnt improve it. And support is always the same i.e. reboot phone and watch, remove watch profile add again. A great pity as checking map on phone without taking phone out saves phone battery and is such a great idea. Execution is hopeless though...
author: frnkfntn

title: Recommend
content: Such a cool app, easy to track maps, so many recommendations for in any area, multiple types of trails/hikes etc. You can also just go for walks and track you’re own walk and details
author: Julita McK

title: Love the app
content: All Trails is an amazing app to find the best trails around your area. The choice of difficulty levels makes it easy to decide which trail you’d want to go to. Also, it lets you know if the trail is dog friendly and that’s helpful too.
author: SnigdhaKotnala

title: A must have app for beginners!
content: this app is incredible for information on any area you are wanting to visit! great track information and safety features! Really wish I had this when I first started hiking!
author: Lovedeemumof2

title: 4WD Driving & Hiking
content: Have used this app to track & share 4WD tracks with friends and club members - they like the stats and 3D recap. Also use the app to track progress on downloaded hiking tracks and to find tracks close to where I am.  Have used the app across the world with great success.
author: Sparrowfarts

title: Good but map isn’t usable
content: My main problem is that, when looking a trail on the map, it will deselect the trail as soon as the map marker is off-screen, which will stop highlighting the trail path. This means you are unable to zoom into the majority of the trail that’s not right next to the marker, and makes the map useless for any detailed zoom. I do not understand why it works that way.
author: 1Dan234

title: One of my favourite apps!!!
content: This app is so good! I love how you can filter searches to find exactly what you want! I love all the information it offers about the walk, including other walker’s reviews. It’s awesome and has inspired me to walk more.
author: stephsek1308

title: Fantastic
content: All Trails is the best way to get out and explore a new area or travel destination! I’ve found All Trails a much easier and quicker than google when it comes to finding new places to explore!
author: Liseyxx

title: Customer service lacking
content: I have been enjoying this app, however I had a simple question about elapsed time versus ride time (you see ride time while recording but then only see elapsed time adter uploading) and I got a single sentence reply which was really rude.  I have asked for further clarification and they have been ignoring me since. I have turned off ky subscription and wish I hadn’t paid for it. Customer service goes a long way guys.
author: Jugglingparr

title: All trails
content: awesome app connects to apple fitness everything you need. The subscription is 34$ a year, comparing Starvas 99$ a year, All trails subscription even comes with more features. highly recommended, as i upgraded to this app from strava.
author: 29CD

title: Almost a great app
content:
Is a handy app due to the sheer number of users, and their contributions of well-mapped, unique and out-of-the-way trails.

However for an app that is partially aimed at mapping and navigating for MTB, it lacks 2 key features that help with hands free use: keeping north up while navigating, and overriding screen time-out on ios. Avenza maps has both of these features.

Not fantastic for MTB users due to these reasons. I’m reluctant to subscribe until these features are added.

For other users who can easily grab their phone from their pocket and hold it while navigating, I’m sure it’s a brilliant tool.
author: Robot1010

title: Love All Trails
content: I use All Trsils every trip I go on. We have discovered beautiful tracks and stunning scenery which we would never have known about otherwise. I have recommended All Trails yo friends and family who all use it now.
author: sbrownbr

title: Very helpful
content: I need to hike every week for my business so searching for trails and using it is great on trail. I never use the navigation as it chews up your battery very quickly. there are too many trails marked as hiking when they should not, as they are for bikes or vehicles.
author: ResponsibleGaming:-)

title: Great offline functionality
content:
One of the best Apps I have ever used. 

The ability to create your own route on your laptop and download it for offline use when out on the trail is excellent. The safety benefits of this combined with the Lifeline feature are huge.
author: Al Findlay

title: Great App
content: Love this app for finding great hikes in our local area and also places we’re visiting. The ability to comment on the trail to give others current information is really helpful
author: W!seguyz

title: Must Have
content: This app is great.  Worth it to pay for the full feature version if you go out regularly.  Invaluable when finding a good hike as well as when you’re on the trail.
author: Iamaleoboy

title: Hiker’s guide
content: I found this app very helpful when finding and planning a walk or hike. Information such as difficulty, time, route map and things to remember are so much helpful when planning.
author: Ruki 17

title: Disappointed with customer service
content: Something went wrong when I purchased pro version 2 weeks ago.  It will not allow me to access the pro version. Have sent 2 emails 2 weeks ago to all trails but no response. Have followed the tips on Help page but still not working. I don’t like to give bad reviews especially as this looks like a great product but not sure how else to get their attention.
author: janeyzap

title: THE App for the travelling hiker
content: Wherever you go, AllTrails has suggestions for your next hike with easy to find regional map and all the options marked. Includes valuable feedback from hikers who have done the hike before.
author: Wombat Ash

title: Comment filter
content:
Could you please make the comments filterable by activity? I am not really interested in what hikers have to say about a trail if I want to go for a trail run or mountain biking.
If there is a way to filter them already, I couldn’t find where that feature is located.
author: Prad_90

title: I love AllTrails
content: I’m so glad I was told about this app. It has definitely helped us become more adventurous by giving us the knowledge and confidence of where we can get out there and create memories
author: Manda242400
